summary: 工时是被低估的调整边际:西雅图UW证据显示$13档低薪岗位工时降6-7%、月均报酬降约$74,即便时薪升约3%。'近零就业(人数)'因此可能掩盖真实的工时与总收入损失——就业冲击部分从headcount转移到intensive margin。

evidence.title: Jardim:月报酬下降
evidence.quote: the Ordinance lowered the amount paid to workers in low-wage jobs by an average of $74 per month per job in 2016

evidence.title: Jardim:工时下降
evidence.quote: the second wage increase to $13 reduced hours worked in low-wage jobs by 6-7 percent

open_questions: 工时下降在其他城市(非西雅图高成本环境)是否同样出现?
